scenarios.scenario: The advisory planner honors advise.max_comments_per_pr: 0 by returning should_comment=false and writing no comment artifact.
The GitHub advisory workflow does not expose GH_TOKEN or github.token while executing checked-out Relia code.
The GitHub advisory workflow disables persisted checkout credentials before executing checked-out Relia code.
Provider-backed distill rejects provider base URLs that include user-info or embedded credentials before those values can appear in command output.
The GitHub advisory workflow seeds local advisory state from an existing hidden-marker comment before running the token-free planner.
The GitHub advisory workflow runs trusted base-branch Relia code and memory rules against the PR diff instead of executing PR-controlled planner code.
The GitHub advisory workflow uses pull_request_target while still pinning base-branch checkout so fork PRs can receive advisory comments without executing PR code.
The GitHub advisory workflow authenticates hidden advisory markers by the expected bot author before using a prior fingerprint or updating an existing comment.
The advisory planner suppresses changed-fingerprint reassessment inside advise.reassess_debounce_minutes when a fresh prior advisory marker exists.
The GitHub advisory workflow paginates and flattens all issue-comment pages before looking up the hidden advisory marker.
The GitHub advisory workflow publish step parses planner JSON directly and invokes gh without sourcing planner-controlled shell environment text while the Actions token is present.
The GitHub advisory workflow publish step keeps a parseable Python heredoc for both update and create advisory comment paths.
The advisory planner still writes one hidden-marker PR advisory plan with real PR citations and skips unchanged diff fingerprints.
The advisory planner stays silent for covered_clean assessments when no prior advisory marker exists.
The advisory planner updates an existing advisory marker with a cleared covered-clean advisory instead of leaving stale warning text.
The advisory planner clears a stale warning when the same diff fingerprint is now covered clean, then records risk_level=covered_clean so subsequent unchanged runs skip.
The advisory planner renders PR-controlled touched paths as safe Markdown code spans before publishing bot comments.
The local MCP serve manifest exposes playbook citations only for fix_held or merged_clean evidence when a playbook also has failure provenance.
The local MCP serve manifest fails closed before serving an active rule with an invalid provenance citation URL.
The advisory planner preserves the prior commented fingerprint and timestamp when a changed diff is skipped by the reassessment debounce window.
